speaker: you
text: Where am I?

speaker: you
text: The door doesn't open. Not from this side.

speaker: stranger
text: You're awake. Good. Don't try to remember. Not yet.

speaker: stranger
text: Something broke time. Now it runs backwards, like a reflection in a mirror.

speaker: stranger
text: In a reversed world the hunter becomes the hunted, and every blow comes back to the one who struck it.

speaker: stranger
text: This helmet lets you walk the broken timelines, back to the moment it all cracked.

speaker: stranger
text: Find the crack. Close it. Whatever it costs.

speaker: stranger
text: Put this on.

speaker: stranger
text: The helmet. Please.

speaker: elder
text: Welcome to the simulation, traveler. I am the Wise Elder.

speaker: elder
text: Nothing here is real, and nothing here can truly hurt you.

speaker: elder
text: I can train you. Or, if your hands still remember, I can send you straight on.

speaker: elder
text: Will you train with me?

speaker: elder
text: Good. Patience is a blade too.

speaker: elder
text: Very well. Take the Divine Sword and the Mirror Shield.

speaker: elder
text: Remember one thing. A mirror returns what it is given. Strike your reflection, and you strike yourself.

speaker: elder
text: Go. The first broken timeline is waiting.

speaker: system
text: WASD to move. Space to dash.
say: Move with W A S D. Press space to dash.

speaker: system
text: [E] Take the Divine Sword

speaker: system
text: Left click to strike. Aim with the mouse.
say: Left click to strike. Aim with your mouse.

speaker: system
text: Strike three times in a row to finish with a spin.
say: Strike three times in a row, to finish with a spin.

speaker: system
text: Break the crates. Red barrels explode.
say: Break the crates. Red barrels explode.

speaker: system
text: [E] Take the Mirror Shield

speaker: system
text: Stand close to the dummy. Hold right click to block.

speaker: system
text: Block just as it lands. The mirror sends it back.
say: Block just as it lands. The mirror sends it back.

speaker: system
text: A shard of a broken timeline. Step through.

speaker: system
text: Good.

speaker: system
text: HYPNO REVERSE UNLOCKED

speaker: system
text: [Q] Hypno Reverse: their attacks become yours.
say: Press Q. Hypno Reverse turns their attacks back on them.

speaker: system
text: CONTROLS REVERSED

speaker: system
text: THE PACK HAS TURNED

speaker: system
text: Survive.

speaker: system
text: SANITY LOST

speaker: system
text: [F] Use your world weapon.

speaker: narrator
text: The Fallen City. The present day, three days after the sky cracked.

speaker: narrator
text: The First Hunt. Ten thousand years ago.

speaker: narrator
text: The Hollow Future. The world you made.

speaker: you
text: They came through the cracks. Hold the line.

speaker: you
text: The portal holds. Go.

speaker: you
text: Here, I'm the stranger. Everything runs from me.

speaker: you
text: Now I'm the prey.

speaker: you
text: The hunt is over. Take what you earned.

speaker: you
text: It's running. Strike now!

speaker: you
text: Go before they remember you.

speaker: you
text: This is what's left. This is what I did.

speaker: you
text: Something waits at the heart of this place.

speaker: you
text: The last fragment is waiting.

speaker: you
text: I sense something nearby...

speaker: you
text: I smell something good!

speaker: you
text: A Flare Bow. Arrows made of light.

speaker: you
text: A Hunter's Axe. Heavy. Honest.

speaker: you
text: An Echo Wand. It hums with a future that shouldn't exist.

speaker: you
text: Something's wrong with me... I can't stop.

speaker: echo
text: Evacuation notice: the creatures are not attacking. They are running.

speaker: echo
text: Day three. The lights in the sky look like campfires.

speaker: echo
text: The first hunter was afraid too.

speaker: echo
text: Every mirror here faces the past.

speaker: echo
text: They crossed time to escape this. In your story, they became the invaders.

speaker: terminal
text: REFUGEE LOG 0417
say: Refugee log. Zero four one seven.

speaker: terminal
text: The breach opened here. The one who made it carried a mirror.

speaker: terminal
text: We fled into the past. To them, we look like invaders.

speaker: terminal
text: His reflection never left. It waits at the heart of the breach.

speaker: hypnotic
text: Look at me. Closer. ...Which way is up now?

speaker: hypnotic
text: You'll see it too. Soon.

speaker: warden
text: Hold the portal. Whatever it costs.

speaker: warden
text: ...It's already too late for us.

speaker: sentinel
text: You again. You always come back.

speaker: sentinel
text: We only wanted somewhere to run.

speaker: evil
text: Finally. You walked all the way back to me.

speaker: evil
text: I am your reflection. Every enemy you cut down, every artifact you took. I am made of all of it.

speaker: evil
text: You broke time trying to win. The breach feeds on that. It feeds me.

speaker: evil
text: As long as you fight, I grow. You can't outfight yourself.

speaker: evil
text: Again.

speaker: evil
text: Stronger. Thank you.

speaker: evil
text: You can't outfight yourself.

speaker: evil
text: Every hit feeds me.

speaker: evil
text: There's only one way this ends.

speaker: evil
text: I know that trick. I am that trick.

speaker: evil
text: Mirror.

speaker: evil
text: Too late. You died too many times. There's more of me in you than you.

speaker: stranger
text: The crack closes only when the one who made it is gone.

speaker: narrator
text: [E] Turn the blade on yourself.

speaker: narrator
text: A mirror returns what it is given. You gave it everything.

speaker: stranger
text: An echo can't die. It only repeats.

speaker: stranger
text: But every return leaves less of you, and more of your reflection.

speaker: stranger
text: Careful. There's more reflection in you than you now.

speaker: reflection
text: I'm your reflection. The part of you that still wants to save them. Let's go.

speaker: reflection
text: I'm still with you.

speaker: reflection
text: I can't follow you anymore. You're becoming the other one.

speaker: narrator
text: The last fragment shows only you.

speaker: narrator
text: It moves first.

speaker: narrator
text: Everything you took, it took too.

speaker: narrator
text: Only one of you leaves. Neither of you can win.

speaker: narrator
text: The mirror is quiet.

speaker: narrator
text: Time turns forward again. Somewhere ahead, a sky stays whole.

speaker: narrator
text: No one will remember you.

speaker: narrator
text: That was the point.

speaker: evil
text: The mirror smiles.

speaker: evil
text: Your reflection walks out into the world, wearing your face.

speaker: evil
text: The breach never closes. It only grows.

speaker: evil
text: Somewhere, someone is running from you.
